name: 十回の学習の進み方
prompt: Edit the supplied current candidate as a strict color-only correction. Preserve the exact 10-step, two-row, five-column tracker, all positions, circle sizes, checkmark and play glyph shapes, numeral glyphs, spacing, typography, canvas size, and white background. Remove every tint, gradient, shading, texture, glow, shadow, highlight, and color variation from the interiors. Fill each completed circle (steps 1 and 2) with a single uniform opaque solid green #30964B (RGB 48,150,75) across every interior pixel. Fill the current circle (step 3) with a single uniform opaque solid blue #2D6CF7 (RGB 45,108,247) across every interior pixel. Keep steps 4–10 white with plain neutral light-gray outlines and plain neutral light-gray play glyphs; keep the checkmarks and step-3 play glyph white; keep numerals 1–3 black and 4–10 gray. No translucent overlay or pale color wash anywhere. Match the supplied owner reference’s geometry and state meaning; use its colored circles only as position/state references, not as shading or gradient instructions. Deliver a clean, flat UI image. Do not add, remove, or redraw content.
reviewNotes: Green and blue drift from owner reference; fill interiors still vary. Registered as a rejected color pass before deterministic flat-vector proof.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
